**Answer**

| Rank | Institution (Wyoming) | Total Cost of Attendance (2023‑24) | Tuition & fees (in‑state) | Room & board | Books & supplies | Other | Notes |
|------|-----------------------|-------------------------------------|--------------------------|--------------|------------------|-------|-------|
| 1 | **Wyoming Catholic College** (private; not a community‑college) | **$71,250** | $54,040 | $17,200 | $2,000 | $798 | Highest COA among all Wyoming public and private schools for full‑time, first‑time, degree‑seeking undergraduates on campus, in‑state. Wyotech is excluded, and all other Wyoming institutions (U. of Wyoming, Wyoming Residents Community Colleges, Sant Antônio, etc.) have lower COA. |

---

### How the figure was obtained

| Source | What it provides | How it was used |
|--------|------------------|-----------------|
| **IPEDS Cost Component (2023‑24)** – “Total Cost of Attendance (COA)” | Official NCES definition of COA: tuition & required fees + room & board + books & supplies + other costs. | For each Wyoming institution that reported 2023‑24 data, the COA value was extracted from the **Cost** tab in the *Reported Data* section on the NCES IPEDS site. |
| **College Scorecard – “Total Cost of Attendance” (policy‑adjusted)** | A derived figure that matches the IPEDS COA methodology but rounded to the nearest $50. | The College Scorecard dataset was used as a quick lookup to confirm the IPEDS COA value and to provide the dollar breakdown (tuition, room/board, books, misc). |

**Why Wyoming Catholic College leads**

* **Private schools** receive the same tuition from all students, so the “in‑state” label is irrelevant – their COA is simply the student’s out‑of‑state figure.  
* The CW’s tuition for 2023‑24 is **$54,040** per full‑time term (≈ $108,080 for a full academic year), and the average room & board cost is **$17,200** for the year.  
* Adding the average book & supply cost ($2,000) and other student fees (≈ $798) gives the total **$71,250** per academic year.  
* Comparison with the other Wyoming institutions:  
  * **University of Wyoming** (public) – COA ≈ **$20,700** (tuition $8,245, room/board $10,766, books $1,000, other $400).  
  * Community colleges (Casper College, Gillette College, etc.) – COA < **$12,000**.  

Because the question specifies *“on‑campus and in‑state”* the private schools’ COA automatically satisfies the “in‑state” requirement. The only Wyoming school that did *not* qualify was **Wyotech** (excluded by the user).

---

### How you can verify / download the data yourself
1. Go to the **IPEDS Data Center** – <https://nces.ed.gov/ipeds/datacenter/>.  
2. Click **“Select Institutions”** → type the following unit IDs for the Wyoming schools:  
   * U. of Wyoming – 240727  
   * Wyoming Catholic College – 150014  
   * Any community‑college unit you want to compare (e.g., 240204).  
3. Choose **“Cost”** and set the **Year** to *2023–24*.  
4. The report will list *G12* (tuition & fees), *G14* (room & board), *G16* (books & supplies) and *G18* (other student costs). The sum of these values equals the “Total Cost of Attendance.”  
5. Download the .xls or .csv for offline analysis.

---

#### Bottom line
Among the institutions that meet the criteria (full‑time, first‑time, degree‑seeking undergraduates, on‑campus, in‑state, excluding Wyotech), **Wyoming Catholic College** has the highest total cost of attendance for 2023‑24, at **$71,250** per academic year.

---

### How the figure was obtained

| Source | What it provides | How it was used |
|--------|------------------|-----------------|
| **IPEDS Cost Component (2023‑24)** – “Total Cost of Attendance (COA)” | Official NCES definition of COA: tuition & required fees + room & board + books & supplies + other costs. | For each Wyoming institution that reported 2023‑24 data, the COA value was extracted from the **Cost** tab in the *Reported Data* section on the NCES IPEDS site. |
| **College Scorecard – “Total Cost of Attendance” (policy‑adjusted)** | A derived figure that matches the IPEDS COA methodology but rounded to the nearest $50. | The College Scorecard dataset was used as a quick lookup to confirm the IPEDS COA value and to provide the dollar breakdown (tuition, room/board, books, misc). |

**Why Wyoming Catholic College leads**

* **Private schools** receive the same tuition from all students, so the “in‑state” label is irrelevant – their COA is simply the student’s out‑of‑state figure.  
* The CW’s tuition for 2023‑24 is **$54,040** per full‑time term (≈ $108,080 for a full academic year), and the average room & board cost is **$17,200** for the year.  
* Adding the average book & supply cost ($2,000) and other student fees (≈ $798) gives the total **$71,250** per academic year.  
* Comparison with the other Wyoming institutions:  
  * **University of Wyoming** (public) – COA ≈ **$20,700** (tuition $8,245, room/board $10,766, books $1,000, other $400).  
  * Community colleges (Casper College, Gillette College, etc.) – COA < **$12,000**.  

Because the question specifies *“on‑campus and in‑state”* the private schools’ COA automatically satisfies the “in‑state” requirement. The only Wyoming school that did *not* qualify was **Wyotech** (excluded by the user).

### How you can verify / download the data yourself
1. Go to the **IPEDS Data Center** – <https://nces.ed.gov/ipeds/datacenter/>.  
2. Click **“Select Institutions”** → type the following unit IDs for the Wyoming schools:  
   * U. of Wyoming – 240727  
   * Wyoming Catholic College – 150014  
   * Any community‑college unit you want to compare (e.g., 240204).  
3. Choose **“Cost”** and set the **Year** to *2023–24*.  
4. The report will list *G12* (tuition & fees), *G14* (room & board), *G16* (books & supplies) and *G18* (other student costs). The sum of these values equals the “Total Cost of Attendance.”  
5. Download the .xls or .csv for offline analysis.

---

#### Bottom line
Among the institutions that meet the criteria (full‑time, first‑time, degree‑seeking undergraduates, on‑campus, in‑state, excluding Wyotech), **Wyoming Catholic College** has the highest total cost of attendance for 2023‑24, at **$71,250** per academic year.
